questions.question_english: 85. Mahavir Harina Vanasthali National Park in Telangana was named in commemoration of Lord Mahavira’s 2500th birth anniversary to preserve which animal?
questions.explanation_english: Mahavir Harina Vanasthali National Park, located in Vanasthalipuram near Hyderabad, was established in 1975 and named to commemorate the 2500th birth anniversary of Lord Mahavira. Spanning over 3,700 acres, this protected park was specifically set aside to preserve the Blackbuck (Antilope cervicapra), the state animal of Andhra Pradesh, alongside spotted deer, monitor lizards, wild boars, and various endemic woodland bird species.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। महावीर हरिना वनस्थली राष्ट्रीय उद्यान, जो हैदराबाद के निकट वनस्थलीपुरम में स्थित है, 1975 में स्थापित किया गया था और इसे भगवान महावीर की 2500वीं जयंती की स्मृति में नामित किया गया था। यह संरक्षित पार्क 3,700 एकड़ में फैला हुआ है और इसे विशेष रूप से काले बक्री (Antilope cervicapra) के संरक्षण के लिए निर्धारित किया गया था, जो आंध्र प्रदेश का राज्य पशु है, इसके साथ ही चित्तीदार हिरण, मॉनिटर छिपकली, जंगली सूअर और विभिन्न स्थानीय वन्य पक्षियों की प्रजातियाँ भी यहाँ पाई जाती हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Blackbuck
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Mahavir Harina Vanasthali National Park was established to preserve the Blackbuck.

questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Environment and Ecology of India
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question_english: 69. High concentrations of fluoride in drinking water in several districts of Telangana cause which endemic health condition?
questions.explanation_english: Prolonged human consumption of groundwater containing elevated concentrations of fluoride exceeding 1.5 milligrams per liter causes fluorosis, an endemic health condition widespread across several districts of Telangana. Fluorosis manifests as dental fluorosis, causing tooth discoloration and enamel decay, and skeletal fluorosis, resulting in painful joint stiffness, severe bone deformities, and crippling impairment due to cumulative fluoride deposition in human bones.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। लंबे समय तक 1.5 मिलीग्राम प्रति लीटर से अधिक फ्लोराइड वाले भूजल का मानव उपभोग फ्लोरोसिस का कारण बनता है, जो तेलंगाना के कई जिलों में व्यापक रूप से फैला एक अंतर्निहित स्वास्थ्य रोग है। फ्लोरोसिस दंत फ्लोरोसिस के रूप में प्रकट होता है, जो दांतों का रंग बदलने और इनेमल के क्षय का कारण बनता है, और कंकाली फ्लोरोसिस, जो दर्दनाक जोड़ों की कठोरता, गंभीर हड्डी विकृतियों और मानव हड्डियों में संचयी फ्लोराइड जमा होने के कारण होने वाली गंभीर अक्षमता का कारण बनता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Fluorosis

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Prolonged human consumption of groundwater containing elevated concentrations of fluoride exceeding 1.5 milligrams per liter causes fluorosis, an endemic health condition widespread across several districts of Telangana.

questions.question_english: 66. What responsibility is imposed on manufacturers and producers under the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022 to ensure the recycling of electronic waste?
questions.explanation_english: Under the E-Waste Management Rules 2022 notified by MoEFCC, Extended Producer Responsibility mandates that manufacturers, importers, and brand owners of electrical and electronic equipment remain financially and environmentally responsible for collecting and recycling end-of-life electronic products. EPR targets aim to channel e-waste into authorized recyclers, promote circular economy practices, and prevent environmental contamination from hazardous heavy metals like lead and mercury.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। ई-अपशिष्ट प्रबंधन नियम, 2022 के तहत निर्माताओं और उत्पादकों को विस्तारित उत्पादक जिम्मेदारी (EPR) के अंतर्गत इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उत्पादों के पुनर्चक्रण की जिम्मेदारी दी गई है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)

questions.question_hindi: 53. राष्ट्रीय बाघ संरक्षण प्राधिकरण (NTCA) किस अधिनियम के तहत स्थापित एक वैधानिक निकाय है?

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question_english: 53. Under which Act was the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) established as a statutory body?
questions.explanation_english: The National Tiger Conservation Authority is a statutory body established under Section 38IV of the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972, following statutory amendments enacted in 2006. Operating under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, NTCA oversees the implementation of Project Tiger, standardizes reserve management guidelines, enforces anti-poaching protocols, and ensures essential landscape connectivity across declared tiger reserves throughout India.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। राष्ट्रीय बाघ संरक्षण प्राधिकरण (NTCA) वन्यजीव संरक्षण अधिनियम, 1972 के तहत स्थापित एक वैधानिक निकाय है। यह प्राधिकरण 2006 में किए गए वैधानिक संशोधनों के बाद स्थापित हुआ। यह पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय के तहत कार्य करता है और प्रोजेक्ट टाइगर के कार्यान्वयन की निगरानी करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Wildlife Protection Act, 1972
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The National Tiger Conservation Authority is a statutory body established under Section 38IV of the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972.

Influenced by semi-arid climatic conditions and distinct wet and dry seasons, these forests shed their leaves during summer months to conserve moisture. Major timber species in this vegetation zone include Teak (Tectona grandis), Anogeissus latifolia, Terminalia tomentosa, and Madhuca longifolia.

questions.question_english: 76. In which year was the Environment (Protection) Act enacted in India, primarily in response to the United Nations Conference on the Human Environment held at Stockholm in 1972?
questions.explanation_english: The Environment (Protection) Act was enacted by the Parliament of India in 1986 under Article 253 of the Constitution. Promulgated in the wake of the 1984 Bhopal Gas Leak tragedy, the Act implements decisions made at the 1972 United Nations Conference on the Human Environment in Stockholm. It serves as an umbrella framework enabling the Central Government to coordinate environmental protection and control pollution.
